lines.zh: 我碎步窜过灌木，鼻子抽动。
lines.en: I scurry through the brush, nose twitching.

lines.zh: 低着身子走，我不让人看见。
lines.en: I walk hunched so no one spots me.

lines.zh: 脚底抹油似的，我溜得飞快。
lines.en: Light on my feet, I slip along fast.

lines.zh: 绕开那滩水，我讨厌湿脚。
lines.en: I skirt that puddle; wet feet disgust me.

lines.zh: 我抓抓肚子，接着往前走。
lines.en: I scratch my belly and keep going.

lines.zh: 沿树根走，这样不容易被射。
lines.en: I follow the roots so arrows miss me.
My little blade swings as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嗅有没有吃的。
lines.en: I walk and sniff for anything edible.
A twig snaps and I crouch at once.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚步，专挑阴影走。
lines.en: I drag my feet, sticking to shadows.

lines.zh: 肚子咕咕叫，我走得更急。
lines.en: My stomach growls and I hurry.

lines.zh: 我贴着栅栏摸过去，手脚并用。
lines.en: I creep along the fence on all fours.

lines.zh: 我蹲着挠头，想不明白事。
lines.en: I squat and scratch my head, puzzled.
I sharpen this little blade over and over.
I lick my teeth and wait for prey.
Too bright; I shrink into the shade.
Smells like someone's been here.

lines.zh: 我抖抖耳朵，听见远处脚步。
lines.en: Ears twitching, I hear steps far off.

lines.zh: 水边我不去，脚一湿就糟。
lines.en: I keep from the water; wet feet are trouble.
I pick at a rock crack for bugs.
Skinny as I am, I'm vicious.

lines.zh: 我把偷来的东西藏这儿了。
lines.en: I hid the thing I stole right here.
You smell like a coin purse.
I size you up and put a price on you.
You walk like an amateur.
See the blade in my hand?
The more you stare, the more I like it.
I'm deciding which side to hit.
Don't laugh; I hate being laughed at.
You've got iron on you. Iron's good.
Let's greet each other — with knives.
I'm not scared of you; I'm waiting.
That hurts! I'll remember you!
I clutch my arm and back away.
You caught my ribs.
I bare my teeth, blood at my lip.
Hitting me is a poor bargain; I hold grudges.
I grunt, my steps gone crooked.
Poison does nothing to me. Again.
I duck behind a tree and catch my breath.
Stop hitting; I still need to eat.
I'll pay it back. Just wait.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西，我看着。
lines.en: That thing on your belt; I'm watching it.
Hand it over, or I'll take it myself.

lines.zh: 我伸手去够，够不着就跳。
lines.en: I reach for it, and jump if I can't.
That smell makes me drool.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我眼睛就跟着晃。
lines.en: Wave it and my eyes wave too.
Don't tease me with food; I'll snatch it.
One bite and I won't hit you.
I come closer slowly — don't back off yet.
That share in your pocket too. Mine.
Food? Let me sniff if it's real.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我的刀差点掉了。
lines.en: You knock me and my blade nearly drops.
I curse and shuffle back two steps.
Bump me once and I hold a grudge.

lines.zh: 我偷东西的时候，别眨眼。
lines.en: Don't blink while I'm stealing.
I'm small, but I never give way.
You stepped on my foot!
I circle you, hunting for a gap.
Don't crowd me; this is my turf.

lines.zh: 挨着肩过去，我哼了一声。
lines.en: I brush past your shoulder with a grunt.
I shove back; I don't take that lying down.

lines.zh: 我们碰碰额头就算说好了。
lines.en: We touch foreheads and that settles it.

lines.zh: 同类之间也抢东西，只是不杀。
lines.en: We plunder each other too, just not kill.

lines.zh: 它分我半块肉，我记住了。
lines.en: It shared half a piece of meat; I remember.

lines.zh: 两个一起走，胆子就大了。
lines.en: Two of us walking makes us bolder.
We squat by the wall splitting the loot.

lines.zh: 它朝我呲牙，我也呲回去。
lines.en: It bares its teeth; I bare mine back.
Tonight we guard this burrow together.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的铁粒给它看。
lines.en: I show it the brightest iron nugget.

lines.zh: 同伴挠挠背，我也帮着挠。
lines.en: My partner scratches its back; I help.

lines.zh: 说好了，谁先看见谁先上。
lines.en: Agreed: whoever spots the prey strikes first.
Whatever's on the ground is mine.
I scoop it up and stuff it inside my rags.
I pick up an iron nugget and bite it.
This thing can be traded.
I glance back as I grab, afraid of being robbed.
You dropped something. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我抱着这堆东西笑得露牙。
lines.en: I hug the pile and grin toothily.
No room left, so I stuff it in my boot.
I pick up an arrow and snap it, tossing it away.

lines.zh: 地上有个盒子，我撬开看看。
lines.en: A box on the ground; I pry it open.
I see you; don't pretend otherwise.
Now's the time — I lunge.

lines.zh: 你回头那刻，我正好起跳。
lines.en: You turn, and that's when I leap.

lines.zh: 这味道，是我藏起来的金币味。
lines.en: That smell — the gold I hid.
Turning your back was unwise.

lines.zh: 我盯上你的腿，先绊倒你。
lines.en: I fix on your legs to trip you first.
Locked on. Don't think of running.
I charge, teeth clenched, feet sure.
That leather won't stop poison.
My eyes light up and I strike.

lines.zh: 从背后最省事，我选背后。
lines.en: The back is easiest, so I take the back.

lines.zh: 你站着不动？那我可不客气。
lines.en: Standing still? Then I won't be polite.
I arch my back, ready to ram.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我的机会来了。
lines.en: Your steps falter — my chance.

lines.zh: 这一票干完就有得吃了。
lines.en: After this job there'll be something to eat.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置，先绕一圈。
lines.en: I mark your spot and circle first.

lines.zh: 你逃到坡上，我就爬上去。
lines.en: You flee uphill; I climb after you.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐也跟得比你久。
lines.en: Limping, I can still outlast you.
My blade stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你躲门后，我看见影子了。
lines.en: Behind the door — I saw the shadow.
Closer. Just a little closer.
I crouch and wait for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall and come around your flank.

lines.zh: 水我不敢过，可我绕着追。
lines.en: I won't cross water, but I'll go around.

lines.zh: 我舔着刀口，盯着你的喉咙。
lines.en: I lick the blade and eye your throat.
Don't think height makes you safe.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声越来越重了。
lines.en: Your breathing's getting heavier.
I keep following. No rush.

lines.zh: 这块地方我熟，你跑不远的。
lines.en: I know this ground; you won't get far.

lines.zh: 你的箭，我吞下去当饭吃。
lines.en: I'll swallow your arrows and call it dinner.
The moment you stop, I'm on you.
Around the flank, I come from your blind side.
I've no patience — except for a chase.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡一边，我打另一边。
lines.en: Your shield guards one side; I take the other.

lines.zh: 再跑几步，你就没力气了。
lines.en: A few more steps and you'll be spent.
Teeth clenched, I never let go.
One jab — and the blade is poisoned.

lines.zh: 毒会慢慢钻进你骨头里。
lines.en: The poison seeps slowly into your bones.
I slash upward from below.

lines.zh: 你挡了上面，我打你膝盖。
lines.en: You guard high; I hit your knee.
This cut is to teach you manners.
I leap and slam your shoulder.
I cut and withdraw, never brawling.

lines.zh: 你的血沾到我的刀上了。
lines.en: Your blood is on my blade now.
I laugh loud and keep cutting.
Hit you — green froth will rise.

lines.zh: 我砍你的手，让你拿不住剑。
lines.en: I cut your hand so you can't hold the sword.
That one will smart for a while.

lines.zh: 我扑上去乱砍，不讲章法。
lines.en: I pounce and hack wildly, no technique.
You raise the shield; I stab through the gap.
My nails carry a bit of poison too.
Stop blocking; your hands are shaking.
I ram your knee, then add a cut.
That one opened your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我越打越兴奋，笑个不停。
lines.en: The fight excites me; I can't stop laughing.
Backing off won't help; I keep close.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝里爬出来了。
lines.en: I crawl out from a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 有人把我放出来了，正好。
lines.en: Someone released me. How convenient.
I rub my hands, then go looking for trouble.
Nice place. Plenty to grab.

lines.zh: 我从矿道的黑里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dark mine shaft.

lines.zh: 脚下的地我不熟，先看看。
lines.en: Unfamiliar ground — I'll look around first.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I hiss once, by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 从阴影里站出来，别吓着。
lines.en: I step out of the shadow. Don't be startled.
I already have a blade in hand.
This world looks easy to rob.

lines.zh: 我一落地就想喝水，可不敢。
lines.en: The moment I land I want water, but I daren't.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪儿来，我忘了。
lines.en: Don't ask where I'm from; I forgot.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，我竟然不太疼。
lines.en: Fire sears my hide, and oddly it barely hurts.

lines.zh: 摔下来磕到膝盖，我骂了一句。
lines.en: I land hard on my knee and curse.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，手乱抓着往上扑。
lines.en: I can't swim; I thrash upward clawing.

lines.zh: 爆开的气浪把我掀了个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me head over heels.

lines.zh: 飞来的箭被我身上吸住了。
lines.en: The flying arrow sticks in me and is absorbed.

lines.zh: 看不见的力量掐住我的脖子。
lines.en: Unseen force closes on my throat.

lines.zh: 饿得眼前发黑，我抓不住刀。
lines.en: Starving, my sight darkens and I can't grip the blade.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头顶，我跳起来尖叫。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my skull; I jump and shriek.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有了，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Nothing below me — I kick at empty air.
